description: Compact version of Opulus on the same FM engine: a button that makes a new sound at random, four slots to keep sounds in, and morphing between them

params.text: Recalls the sound kept in that slot with a single press, and saves the current sound into it when held for 2 seconds
Turns morph mode on, where the voltage at the morph input interpolates between the saved sounds
Randomizes the engine and produces a new sound

inputs.text: In morph mode this voltage interpolates between the saved sounds: 0V is slot 1, 1V is slot 2, and voltages outside 0-4V are wrapped into that range
The gate that starts the envelopes and releases them when it falls
The velocity of the note, which changes the oscillator levels

notes: morph mode interpolates between sounds already stored in the four slots, so store them first: press RAND for a new sound, then hold a slot button for 2 seconds until its lamp flashes twice
